en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the subject is to acquire knowledge and skills in working with specific topics of the use of plants in landscape architecture.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Indoor plants I (allowance 2/2) a.Division of interior spacesb.Function of indoor plants I2.Interior plants II (allowance 2/2) a.Function of indoor plants IIb.Indoor plants use I3.Interior plants III (allowance 2/2) a.Indoor plants use II4.Plants use special groups of plants in Landscape architecture I (allowance 2/2) a.Utility subtropical plants5.Plants use special groups of plants in Landscape architecture II (allowance 2/2) a.Medicinal, aromatic, spice and honey plants6.Plants use special groups of plants in Landscape architecture III (allowance 2/2) a.Fruit trees and shrubs7.Plants use special groups of plants in Landscape architecture IV (allowance 2/2) a.Ferns8.Plants use special groups of plants in Landscape architecture V (allowance 2/2) a.Vegetables9.Specific ways of using plants in Landscape architecture I (allowance 0/0) a.Dry shade plantsb.Plants resistant to trampling10.Specific ways of using plants in Landscape architecture II (allowance 0/0) a.Village spaceb.Front gardens11.Indoor plants IV (allowance 0/0) a.Winter garden12.Professional excursion or participation of an extern lecturer on a requested topic (allowance 0/0)
